itemized.notes: Pages are internally numbered 2 of 3 and 3 of 3, i.e. the filer numbered only the report proper; the PDF's p3/p4 are those pages. The Schedule A mailing-address block is COUNTY-REDACTED (one solid black bar spanning all four rows), so donor_city/donor_state are blank with 'redacted' in each row note. Three of the four contribution amounts are written as whole dollars with a TRAILING DASH ('$100-') = no cents, transcribed as .00 and noted; the fourth uses raised-superscript cents. Schedule B dates are written out longhand ('Mar 12, 2012'). Field-shift screen: p3 4 dates / 4 names / 4 occupations / 4 amounts; p4 7 dates / 7 recipients / 7 purposes / 7 amounts - PASS. Every contribution is from the candidate or a family member (Larry Decker x3, Don Lee Decker x1) - a self-funded campaign, which is why both sides total identically.
